**Verdict: don't publish yet. Two claims need to change.**

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website | Allowlisted, exact wording (Oct 2026 export) |
| The finest | **Unsupported.** Superlative, banned in policy section 3 |
| organic loose leaf | Allowlisted as "Certified organic by the Soil Association". Better to use the full wording |
| eco-friendly bags | **Unsupported.** A general "eco-friendly" claim is banned. The backed claim is "plastic-free and home compostable" (EN 13432) |
| packed by hand in Bristol | Allowlisted, but the wording is "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol". The draft's sentence implies the bags are hand-packed too, which isn't on file |

Slop and voice: no banned words and no structural problems. Spelling is fine. A hero landing section needs no Ad, Gifted or Affiliate label.

**Suggested replacement (all claims allowlisted)**

> Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website. Certified organic by the Soil Association, with plastic-free, home compostable tea bags. Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol.

Sam needs to approve it before it goes live, since all public content goes through them.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "The finest organic loose leaf", "type": "superlative"}, {"quote": "eco-friendly bags", "type": "green_claim"}], "publish": false}
```
